What is #HMPV Virus?

- Human Metapneumovirus 

- A common respiratory virus

- First identified in 2001, reports indicate it has been in circulation since 1958. 

- Causes symptoms similar to the common cold.

- Can lead to respiratory diseases.

- Spreads in winter
